narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote the Shopee Video Affiliate program by using a comedic skit between a young content creator and his skeptical grandmother. It addresses common misconceptions about making money online and provides a step-by-step tutorial on how anyone can earn commissions through Shopee's short video feature.
